recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to current PractitionerRole cardinalities, names, or narrative should be handled as separate PA work items, not as unfinished application of FHIR-5197.
issue_request: FHIR-5197 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 Practitioner ballot issue asking to group role, period, and location under PractitionerRole, with managingOrganization, role, specialty, period, location, and HealthcareService role-specific properties.
initial_application: Commit 8ed9982708ac31ba37ad6670f9be8ba628634329 explicitly listed tracker 5197 and introduced Practitioner.practitionerRole with nested managingOrganization, role, specialty, period, location, and healthcareService rows in the Practitioner spreadsheet and examples.
additional_context: Later source history intentionally changed the representation from an embedded Practitioner component to a standalone resource: commit ffe864085b20ebb8750d1cb35a7cab404608f944 added PractitionerRole as a draft resource to be extracted from Practitioner, and commit 485ed5cfca20db7b56d9dfb56fbe19c15e3c7641 performed Practitioner Role cleanup after approval in San Antonio. Current source/fhir.ini actively includes both Practitioner and PractitionerRole.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current Practitioner has no legacy role/practitionerRole element, while current PractitionerRole contains the role-specific period, practitioner, organization, code, specialty, location, and healthcareService elements.
